headline: Small SE at 6s, glassy morning — loggable before the onshore.
today: Light and clean at dawn with a 4mph NNE breeze, so the morning is the window at 2ft and 6-7s on a good angle. It goes onshore ESE by afternoon and a cross-on SE ramps to 13mph by evening, so don't wait around. Longboard, mellow session.

daysToWatch.note: E swell fills to 3.3ft with a 10.5s line and the wind stays light — cross-on early but backs off to light SW by evening. The best Squan day this week, worth the look.
Only 1.4-1.7ft but WNW blows offshore all day. Clean and small — decent dawn log if you're close.
